current_answer: PostHog offers USD 50,000 in startup credits for 12 months to qualifying companies under two years old with under USD 5 million raised. A company-domain account and paid usage plan are required before applying. Since 14 September 2026, credits exclude PostHog Desktop, the Slack app, Replay Vision, PostHog AI, and Inbox. A founder should compare expected analytics use with the free allowances and budget AI-tool charges separately; the USD 50,000 is not cash or a general AI budget.

catalogue_card.question: Can PostHog’s USD 50,000 startup credit pay for its AI tools?
catalogue_card.text: No for five named AI tools since 14 September 2026: Desktop, the Slack app, Replay Vision, PostHog AI, and Inbox. Eligible companies can get 12 months of credits for other covered products, but must meet the age, funding, domain, and account gates.

summary: PostHog offers USD 50,000 in eligible product credits for 12 months to companies under two years old with under USD 5 million raised.
A company-domain PostHog account signed up on or after 1 January 2023 and a paid usage plan precede the startup form.
Since 14 September 2026, five named AI tools cannot be paid with startup credits; AI observability and the context warehouse remain covered.
